builds.cache: 0be167f (pipeline with the per-thread block cache, after review fixes)

note: Traced timings inflate builds that make more API calls, so build comparisons use the untraced medians. The baseline's hipFree time includes waits for queued kernels, because hipFree synchronizes the device.
timed_command: python benchmarks/probe_simplify_allocations.py hip 24 50000 60 (three runs per build, builds interleaved, no tracer)
traced_command: rocprofv3 --hip-runtime-trace --stats -d <dir> -o run --output-format csv -- python benchmarks/probe_simplify_allocations.py hip 24 50000 40
workload: One process: a 50,000-term, 24-qubit operator with 50% duplicates; 5 warmup and N timed device-resident simplify calls, then 5 warmup and N timed to_device + simplify + to_host calls. Traced counts cover every hipMalloc and hipFree in the process (90 simplify calls with N = 40), transfers included.
